about: Summerland is a district municipality on the west side of Okanagan Lake in British Columbia’s Okanagan Valley, between Peachland and Penticton—not a large city. Orchards, vineyards, a lakeside town centre, and Giant’s Head mountain define a fruit-growing community. About 12,000 people live in Summerland.
